findings.why_it_matters: The printed clause heading 4.7.4 General Rules (WRITE statement, Sequential I-O) is transcribed as a plain paragraph instead of a '### 4.7.4 General Rules' heading, as its siblings 4.5.4 (REWRITE, page 422) and 4.6.4 (USE, page 424) are. Tools that locate a rule by its clause heading (cite.py, section slicing) cannot find the WRITE general rules under §1985:VII.4.7.4.
